function.name: fix_mtu
function.description: Adjust the network interface MTU to eliminate TLS fragmentation and packet drop issues.

interface.description: Network interface name or service, e.g. Wi-Fi, en0, en10

mtu.description: Target MTU value (e.g. 1280 for cellular hotspots, 1500 for standard ethernet)

function.name: flush_dns
function.description: Flush local macOS DNS cache via dscacheutil and restart mDNSResponder.

function.name: flush_arp
function.description: Flush macOS ARP cache entries to resolve poisoned or stale gateway MAC addresses.

function.name: disable_ipv6
function.description: Disable unrouted IPv6 on local campus LAN to resolve 500ms Happy Eyeballs latency delay.

service.description: Network service name, e.g. Wi-Fi or USB 10/100 LAN

message.content: Analysis shows cellular hotspot MTU is causing TLS packet drops. Executing remediation.
